summary.text: Chanz Green is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 74 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Paul Johnson.
He chairs the Assembly Tourism Committee, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Chanz Green was born in Wisconsin and lives in Grand View.
His career experience includes working in municipal utilities as utility manager of the City of Ashland, and he also owned and operated several small businesses.
Green assumed office in the Assembly on January 3, 2023, succeeding Beth Meyers.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Commerce, Energy and Utilities, Rural Development, Sporting Heritage, State Affairs (vice-chair), and Tourism (chair).
